slots.question: How should the querent build the Assignment 3 deliverable: consumer search triggers/intent, keyword strategy, keyword-to-page mapping, foundational SEO, a Digital PR objective/insight/big idea/execution/outreach/amplification, and an integrated SEO+PR journey with measurement?

slots.decision_needed: Which search/SEO priorities, which Digital PR concept and outreach approach, and which integrated journey and KPIs to commit to in the deck.

question_facets.Q1: Consumer search triggers, search behaviour and intent classification (slides 1-2)

question_facets.Q4: Foundational SEO action plan across on-page / off-page / technical pillars (slide 5)
question_facets.Q5: Digital PR objective, target audience, consumer insight, brand connection, desired outcome (slide 6)
question_facets.Q6: The big PR idea, execution plan, creative assets, media/creator/community outreach, media pitch, amplification (slides 7-10)
question_facets.Q7: Integrated SEO+PR discovery routes, measurement KPIs, three SEO + three PR priorities, strategic conclusion (slides 11-12)

rows.source_sentence: Creative execution. Create at least two sample campaign assets.

rows.text: Outreach must name at least 3 real media outlets/publications and at least 2 real creators/experts/communities (no invented names), plus one media pitch of approximately 100-150 words.
rows.source_sentence: Include: At least 3 relevant media outlets/publications. At least 2 relevant creators, experts, communities or partners ... Research and name actual publications, creators and communities (no inventing names). ... length: Approximately 100 - 150 words

rows.text: The PR campaign must demonstrate at least two PR-worthiness qualities from NEW / DIFFERENT / RELEVANT / HUMAN / DATA-LED / CULTURAL / PURPOSEFUL.
rows.source_sentence: pr_worthiness_requirement: The campaign should demonstrate at least two of these qualities.

rows.text: At least two actions per SEO pillar (six-action plan) and six KPIs across both areas are required.
rows.source_sentence: You must recommend at least two relevant actions for each pillar. / Choose six relevant KPIs across both areas.

rows.text: Free research sources are allowed; paid SEO tools are not required.
rows.source_sentence: You may use Google Search, autocomplete, related searches, Google Trends and other freely accessible research sources. Paid SEO tools are not required.

rows.text: The actual brand name, category and audience from Assignments 1 and 2 are not present in this file and must not be assumed or resolved by the analysis.
rows.source_sentence: Continue from Assignment 1 & 2. (brand identity not stated in project_3.yaml)

rows.text: Keyword volumes, consumer research figures and campaign results must not be invented.
rows.source_sentence: DON'T: Invent keyword volumes, consumer research or campaign results.

rows.text: The analysis must not resolve which specific real publications/creators will accept coverage; only relevance-based shortlisting guidance is permitted.
rows.source_sentence: Earned media is not the same as paid influencer promotion. The outreach plan should focus on relevance and voluntary editorial or community interest.

rows.text: Do not select keywords only because they are popular.
rows.source_sentence: DON'T: Select keywords only because they are popular.

rows.text: Do not copy campaigns discussed in class (IKEA ThisAbles, Swiggy #SwiggyVoiceOfHunger, CRED Indiranagar Ka Gunda, Burger King Moldy Whopper).
rows.source_sentence: DON'T: Copy campaigns discussed in class.

rows.text: Do not confuse Digital PR with paid advertising or routine product/discount/influencer announcements.
rows.source_sentence: DON'T: Confuse Digital PR with paid advertising. / A routine product announcement, discount campaign or generic influencer collaboration is not automatically a Digital PR campaign.

rows.text: Do not choose publications simply because they are famous; do not create attractive visuals without a strong underlying idea.
rows.source_sentence: DON'T: Choose publications simply because they are famous. / Create attractive campaign visuals without a strong underlying idea.
